body_markdown:
NEW YORK, July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —[GPGI, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Id-_sk32icd0_oFPxq16Dz5hlebT2CGCygP-ku3hBeEvZFomoQ6QMmruDV2bkkyDGY7TFGRYx5o5GxHkBEeFtA==) (NYSE: GPGI), a diversified multi-industry platform for companies with great positions in good industries, today announced it will host a conference call on Thursday, August 6, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) to discuss its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. GPGI’s earnings results will be reported in a press release prior to the call.


GPGI’s leadership team will host the conference call, followed by a question-and-answer period.


**Date:** Thursday, August 6, 2026


**Time:** 8:00 a.m. EDT


**Live webcast registration link:**[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=IhtIdKjDLU2ys5nLoqh7M-1511ROeLgXmfxU1fo-ETwb2-4nkrXBtDZTfZXyGnl2DhWV-wQRVHR2tWf4PJGmz46B34BMvYx0vcy5wfpFqJc=)


We encourage all participants to register at least 15 minutes prior to the 8:00 a.m. EDT start time. A live webcast and replay will be available at[https://gpgi.com/events-presentations/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VOkxXfH3g26HXr1obxZ2YMxFkJWOF79ScGKqDUNbyanLm5I9u2fkClAD8TPxQ4Ff_xR-XP4uVRhtoyp1pDXVmQYsEJrQrEpn95tzkAUust6tB5WHdaGvHlbuhz0CUCwDDZxUdIE2ADr_0sEMrAMMLg==) . If you have any difficulty registering for the conference call, please contact GPGI at[ir@gpgi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RQmeTqcr2BIgA-bVTyuaxpG0iLspJNjJNsnOKczhBw-wOKSk3rvxqLw1Lw4rH41x3JmP_0yMH8mNC4LMyJBRvg==) .


**About GPGI**


GPGI, Inc. (NYSE: GPGI) is a diversified, multi-industry platform for companies with great positions in good industries. The platform is managed by Resolute Holdings Management, Inc. (NYSE: RHLD) and is purpose-built to acquire, own, and scale high-quality businesses led by great operators, benefiting from a permanent capital base and the systematic deployment of the Resolute Operating System. GPGI currently consists of CompoSecure and Husky – two market leaders with best-in-class financials and durable opportunities for growth. For more information, please visit[GPGI.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RyZpI5FqPHl1i4QETgjc40tAdOlCOzVgG3Y5hK6izKpjzRD9PFvV4T2j0AYvc8wypZ3gPEf20_x3DU_vsnQNiQ==) .
